abstract_sentences.text: Evaluating robotics policies across thousands of environments and thousands of tasks is infeasible with existing approaches.

evidence.anchor: thousands of environments and thousands of tasks is infeasible

abstract_sentences.text: This motivates the need for a new methodology for scalable robotics policy evaluation.

evidence.anchor: need for a new methodology for scalable robotics policy evaluation

abstract_sentences.text: In this paper, we propose dWorldEval, which uses a discrete diffusion world model as a scalable evaluation proxy for robotics policies.

evidence.anchor: propose dWorldEval ... scalable evaluation proxy

abstract_sentences.text: Specifically, dWorldEval maps all modalities—including vision, language, and robotic actions—into a unified token space, modeling them via a single transformer-based denoising network.

evidence.anchor: maps all modalities ... into a unified token space

abstract_sentences.text: In this paper, we propose dWorldEval, using a discrete diffusion world model as a scalable evaluation proxy for robotics policy.

evidence.anchor: propose dWorldEval ... evaluation proxy for robotics policy

abstract_sentences.text: Specifically, it maps all modalities, including vision, language, and robotics action into a unified token space, then denoises them with a single transformer network.

evidence.anchor: maps all modalities ... then denoises them with a single transformer network

abstract_sentences.text: Building on this architecture, We employ a sparse keyframe memory to maintain spatiotemporal consistency.

evidence.anchor: sparse keyframe memory to maintain spatiotemporal consistency

abstract_sentences.text: We also introduce a progress token that indicates the degree of task completion.

evidence.anchor: introduce a progress token that indicates the degree of task completion

abstract_sentences.text: At inference, the model jointly predicts future observations and progress token, allowing automatically determine success when the progress reaches 1.

evidence.anchor: jointly predicts future observations and progress token ... reaches 1

abstract_sentences.text: Extensive experiments demonstrate that dWorldEval significantly outperforms previous approaches, i.e., WorldEval, Ctrl-World, and WorldGym, on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and multiple real-robot tasks.

evidence.anchor: outperforms ... WorldEval, Ctrl-World, and WorldGym ... LIBERO, RoboTwin

abstract_sentences.text: It paves the way for a new architectural paradigm in building world simulators for robotics evaluation at scale.

evidence.anchor: new architectural paradigm ... evaluation at scale

introduction_moves.move: context: generalist manipulation policies have advanced, while capability evaluation remains difficult; world models are introduced as a scalable alternative. Next hook: reliability.

evidence.anchor: evaluating their capabilities remains a significant challenge

introduction_moves.move: problem: current world models fail to reflect actions and physical interactions; OOD actions and physical inconsistency produce hallucinated success and artifacts. Next hook: root cause.

evidence.anchor: two main causes ... out-of-distribution actions ... physical inconsistency

introduction_moves.move: failure_of_prior_work + missing_insight: failure trajectories cannot cover actions; video backbones inject action as weak auxiliary conditioning, allowing visual priors to override it. Next hook: architectural change.

evidence.anchor: action signals act as weak guidance and are frequently overridden

introduction_moves.move: core_idea + method_preview: train MDD from scratch on robotic data, treat actions and observations as equivalent unified tokens, then add sparse keyframe memory and progress token. Next hook: contributions.

evidence.anchor: trained from scratch on robotic data ... unified token space

introduction_moves.move: contribution_list: list unified token/memory, joint progress prediction, and evaluations with ∆-LPIPS and Pearson r ≈ 0.9. Next hook: related work.

evidence.anchor: In summary, we make three contributions

related_work_moves.move: taxonomy + nearest_neighbor_contrast + gap_creation: classify real rollouts/physics simulators versus data-driven world models, then contrast AdaLN/cross-attention auxiliary actions with unified primary action tokens.

evidence.anchor: actions as auxiliary conditions into a visually-dominated denoiser

related_work_moves.move: chronology + credit_or_foundation + nearest_neighbor_contrast + gap_creation: move from discrete diffusion language models to multimodal models and VLA policy inpainting, then position this paper as a discrete-diffusion world model with joint progress prediction.

evidence.anchor: we employ discrete diffusion to build a world model

final_judgment.single_storyline: 现有 video-diffusion evaluator 把 action 当弱辅助条件，产生 OOD failure hallucination 和 long-horizon drift；dWorldEval 以 robotic-data scratch training 的 unified discrete tokens 让 action 进入 self-attention，再用 sparse keyframe memory 稳定轨迹、progress token 统一 success scoring。主线是 action fidelity → temporal consistency → intrinsic grading → policy ranking（pp. 2–9）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留三项 evaluator properties、五个 RQ、unified token/memory/progress 组件、Eq. (2) ∆LPIPS、Tables 1–4 和 Figures 5–7，以及三类 domain 的核心对照，使机制到 ranking 决策可追踪（pp. 3–9）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 任务 instruction、模型/训练/硬件/runtime、action-shuffle protocol、VLM rubric 与定性 failure/real-world 图移入 pp. 13–20；正文通过 Appendix C/D 引用保持流畅，但 progress supervision、诊断扰动和复现成本离开附录后无法独立判断（pp. 4–5、9、13–20）。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Table 1 并列 expert/failure，Table 2 并列 horizon/memory，Figure 7 同时报告 scatter correlation 与 rank violation；三者把机制变量、压力测试和最终决策量置于同一证据路径（pp. 6、8–9）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 可靠 ranking 与 scalable 的措辞超出可检验范围：r≈0.9 来自有限任务/策略的聚合曲线，未给样本数、误差、seed、per-task breakdown 或 OOD coverage；另有 Table 2 0.243/正文 0.21、history resolution、four/three suites 的内部不一致（pp. 6–9、14）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 把生成质量提升解释为评测能力时，应把 action-conditioned mechanism、long-horizon stress test、真实执行对照和 ranking decision 放入同一链条，同时公开聚合分母和不确定性（pp. 6–9、14–15）。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于把生成模型当 simulator/evaluator 且以相关性或排名为终点的机器人论文；纯视觉生成、无闭环决策目标或理论型论文应改用自身的中介变量与决策量（由本文的 RQ/证据结构归纳，pp. 5–9）。
